name: Helix DS
description: Helix DS tokens: the base set (tokens.json, light and desktop), the theme modifier (dark context: tokens.dark.json) and the viewport modifier (mobile context: tokens.mobile.json). Any DTCG 2025.10 tool resolves Helix's light and dark themes from this file; packages/tokens/src/build.ts does the same to write dist/helix.css.

helix.description: Every Helix token — primitive, semantic and component — with its light value.

theme.description: Color theme. Light is tokens.json as is; dark replaces the tokens in tokens.dark.json, and every token aliasing one of them follows it.

viewport.description: Viewport. Desktop (and tablet, which shares it) is tokens.json as is; mobile — below primitive.breakpoint.tablet — replaces the tokens in tokens.mobile.json: the font sizes of 18px and up shrink to semantic.fontSize.mobile.*.
